bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: Focused multi-query GPU proof: one same-relation target/query table produces N rows in one custom-scan batch, comparing resident batched Vulkan coordinate path against the production SIMD SQL no-index control.

test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_64_SHORT_COORD: 64 dna4 same-relation queries against one 500 kbp target; coordinate-only batch proof
test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_512_SHORT_COORD: 512 dna4 same-relation queries against one 100 kbp target; amortization proof
test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_4096_SHORT_COORD: 4096 dna4 same-relation queries against one 20 kbp target; launch-amortization stress
